title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is studying the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli spaces M_{g,ν}, i.e. a neighbourhood of the boundary divisor Θ of the Deligne–Mumford–Knudsen compactification (normal crossings, at least in the stack sense). On the previous page he struggled with fundamental-groupoid technicalities: Π_1 defined by points and arcs versus Π_1 defined by simply connected coverings. On this page he steps back to a purely topological setting, 'sans nous focaliser sur les π_1'.

(i) A crossed-out opening remark, flagged in the margin 'cf. sans hyp. spécifique crois. normaux'. It notes that the deleted tubular neighbourhood V*_{D_1, D_0=X} can be read as V_{Θ,X} \ Θ, the punctured regular neighbourhood of Θ in X. That space is what 'gives the structure at infinity': the homotopy type, or topos, at infinity of X* = X \ Θ.

(ii) The normal-crossings divisor Θ in the topological manifold ('multiplicité topologique') X defines a decreasing filtration (2.44): Θ^(0) = X ⊃ Θ^(1) = Θ ⊃ Θ^(2) ⊃ ... . Here Θ^(d) is the closed locus where at least d local branches meet.

(iii) One would like to set D_d = the 'topological normalisation' of Θ^(d). This is the space of points of Θ^(d) together with a choice of d local branches; for self-intersecting divisors, as on M̄_{g,ν}, it is not a union of components. Grothendieck observes that this definition may rely on fairly delicate normal-crossings hypotheses in the topological category.

(iv) By contrast, the open strata D_d^* = Θ^(d) \ Θ^(d+1) are defined without such hypotheses. They are manifolds of codimension d (real codimension 2d in the complex case). Each therefore has a tubular neighbourhood V_{D_d^*} and a deleted tubular neighbourhood V*_{D_d^*} ↪ V_{D_d^*}; this is the crossed-out (2.45).

(v) Next page: these data are organised into a semi-simplicial system V*_{d_0...d_r}, indexed by chains d_0 ≥ ... ≥ d_r. A 'recollement theorem' then asserts that the colimit of the semi-simplicial topos of deleted neighbourhoods of strata is equivalent to the topos of the punctured neighbourhood at infinity V*_{Θ,X}. Hence the homotopy type at infinity is reconstructed from the strata and their links.

In modern terms this is the decomposition of the link, or boundary homotopy type, of a normal-crossings compactification along the strata of the divisor. The page is preparatory to that statement.
errors: No mathematical error. The claim that D_d^* is defined without normal-crossings hypotheses is fine as a definition. However, the existence of good tubular neighbourhoods V_{D_d^*} in a purely topological manifold also needs some tameness hypothesis (e.g. Thom–Mather control data, or the algebraic/analytic structure). Grothendieck leaves this implicit, consistent with his later 'topologie modérée' programme.
Notational looseness: Θ^(1) = Θ is written both as a filtration step and as the divisor. On the next page the strata index uses ≥ and > 0 inconsistently (a draft-level issue).

ideas.what: Filtration of a normal-crossings divisor by multiplicity, Θ^(d) = locus of ≥ d branches, with open strata Θ^(d)\Θ^(d+1)
ideas.modern_name: Canonical stratification of a normal crossings divisor
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (Deligne, Hodge II, 1971, for the weight filtration via normalisations of Θ^(d))
ideas.where_published: Implicit in SGA 7 / Deligne's work; Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 discusses stratified structures generally

ideas.what: Normalisation of Θ^(d) as the space of points with a choice of d local branches, and the remark that defining it topologically needs delicate hypotheses
ideas.modern_name: Normalisation of strata, Ã^(d) (Deligne's resolution of a NC divisor)

ideas.what: Using tubular and deleted tubular neighbourhoods of open strata, V*_{D_d^*} ↪ V_{D_d^*}, as building blocks for the 'structure at infinity' of M_{g,ν}
ideas.modern_name: Links of strata / homotopy links (Quinn), control data (Thom–Mather), boundary homotopy type of moduli space
ideas.usually_credited_to: Thom, Mather (1960s–70s); Quinn (homotopy links, 1988); for M_g boundary: Harer, Ivanov, Boggi
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §§5–6 ('structure à l'infini' of M_{g,ν', dévissage of stratified structures, tubular neighbourhoods)

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a purely topological, normal-crossings-free version of the dévissage of the neighbourhood at infinity of M_{g,ν}, using only the open strata Θ^(d)\Θ^(d+1). It leads to a topos-theoretic recollement theorem on the next page. Only its general shape is announced in the Esquisse.
missed.quote: Par contre, D_d^* = Θ^(d) \ Θ^(d+1) [se] définit sans telles hypothèses
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a precursor to exit-path / stratified-homotopy descriptions of the boundary of moduli spaces. It is a modest unpublished detail of the Esquisse programme rather than a new result.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine setup: a stratification of a normal-crossings divisor and tubular neighbourhoods of strata. Its interest lies only as the documented working-out of the 'structure à l'infini' / dévissage programme announced in the Esquisse; the more substantive recollement statement is on the next page.
transcription_corrections: Top (crossed out): likely 'Indépendamment de ce fait, [il] vient que V*_{D_1,D_0=X} peut s'interpréter comme V_{Θ^(1),X} \ Θ^(1) — il donne la "structure à l'infini"' (with a star on V).
Margin addition reads approximately 'cf. sans hyp. spécifique "crois. normaux"'.
'Reprenons la situation du vt des var topologiques' is uncertain; possibly 'Reprenons la situation dans le cas topologique' or similar.
'D_d = Θ^(d)' should likely be 'D_d = Θ̃^(d)', the normalisation, given the tilde mark and the phrase '"normalisé topologique" de Θ^(d)'.
Crossed-out line: 'a définit sans telles hypothèses, dans ensuite' is more plausibly 'se définit sans telles hypothèses, d'où aussi (2.45) V_{D_d^*} et V*_{D_d^*} ↪ V_{D_d^*}'.
